name: War-Awoken Brothership Ray (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒ブラザーシップレイ
effects: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Poison, Fire, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Poison, Fire, Lightning Ability DEF and RES 40% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Dualcast Poison, Fire, Lightning (Tactical) 5] to user if Level 2+ EnPoison or EnFire or EnLightning, grants [Attach Poison 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] to user if not.
